blocks.title: Custom Hospitality Software Development Company in India
blocks.content: DigITHack builds powerful hospitality software solutions for restaurants, cafes, salons, spas, hotels, and cloud kitchens across India. From small local salons in Pune to multi-outlet restaurant chains in Mumbai and Delhi, our systems help hospitality businesses manage bookings, billing, staff, and customer relationships seamlessly. We design fast, reliable, and easy-to-use software so your team can focus on delivering great customer experiences while we handle the technology.

FAQs.question: How much does hospitality management software cost?
FAQs.answer: Pricing depends on features and number of outlets. Small businesses start from ₹25,000 one-time or ₹2,000/month. Multi-branch systems cost more based on customization.

FAQs.question: Does it support GST billing?
FAQs.answer: Yes. Our software is fully GST compliant with reports and invoice formats.

FAQs.question: Can I manage multiple outlets?
FAQs.answer: Yes. You can manage multiple branches from a single dashboard.

FAQs.question: Does it work offline?
FAQs.answer: Yes. Billing works offline and syncs automatically when internet returns.

FAQs.question: Do you provide training?
FAQs.answer: Yes. We provide full staff training and ongoing support.
